    What's special

    All brick building
    All utilities are included! 3b/1b, 1733sf second floor unit in a beautiful two units all brick building within walking distance to UW Hospital and Clinics, VA Hospital at Madison, WI for rent. Rent includes electricity, gas, winter heat, hot and cold water, sewage, laundry and 2 car parking. Tenants are responsible for lawn maintenance and snow removal. It's available on June 1, 2026. Credit score 700, income 3.5x rent or above to be qualified. Please click "Apply Now" below to submit a rental application for a showing if interested. Maximum three occupants are allowed in this unit given that there is only one bathroom. In order to minimize the disturbance to current tenant, showing would only be scheduled for request with a qualified rental application submitted from Zillow. We apologize for inconvenience and thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Electricity, gas, hot and cold water, winter heat, sewage, laundry and two car parking are included in the rent. Tenants are responsible for lawn care and snow removal.
